slides.label: The story
slides.title:
Born under
the Moon’s star
body: Krishna was born under Rohini, a star in Taurus, the sign where the Moon is at her best.

slides.label: His family
slides.title:
The Moon’s
family line
body: His people, the Yadus, came down from Soma, the Moon. Rama, the Sun’s avatar, came from the Sun’s line.

slides.label: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra · ch. 3
slides.title:
Kind eyes,
sweet words
body: Parashara draws the Moon with kind eyes, sweet speech and a restless nature. The Moon is also the mind.

slides.label: In your chart
slides.title: Your Moon’s house
body: The house of your Moon shows where your heart goes, and where people feel at home with you.
